# Altradits

Altradits makes kTown, a free Bitcoin till for shops in Kisumu, Kenya.
Start here: https://altradits.com/

## kTown: your till takes bitcoin, you get M-Pesa

- The shop registers with its M-Pesa number and prints one QR:
  https://altradits.com/ktown
- Customers scan the QR with any Lightning wallet and pay in sats.
- The shop gets Kenyan shillings in M-Pesa, with an M-Pesa code per payment.
- kTown is free. Tando converts sats to M-Pesa for a 1 percent fee, which the
  customer covers on the kTown pay page.
- kTown never holds money and is not a wallet. Sats go to Tando, and Tando
  pays M-Pesa straight to the shop's number.
- The pilot is open to shops in Kisumu, with limited places.
- Terms: https://altradits.com/ktown/terms
- Questions or a shop visit: https://altradits.com/contact
